name: Kanojo no Hahaoya ~Uchi no Musume da to Omotte... ne?~
original_name: 彼女の母親～ウチの娘だと思って…ね？～
source:
Yukino has a daughter, Emi. One day, Emi brings her boyfriend to her house. But they have a quarrel and she leaves the house.... Yukino enters Emi's room and says to him, "Well, I'll teach you how to have sex...."

[FromErogeShop]
